演.english: to perform (a play etc); to stage (a show); (bound form) to develop; to play out; to carry out (a task)

卻.english: but; yet; however; while; to go back; to decline; to retreat; nevertheless; even though

料.english: material; stuff; grain; feed; to expect; to anticipate; to guess

做.english: to make; to produce; to write; to compose; to do; to engage in; to hold (a party etc); (of a person) to be (an intermediary, a good student etc); to become (husband and wife, friends etc); (of a thing) to serve as; to be used for; to assume (an air or manner)

殺.english: to kill; to slay; to murder; to attack; to weaken; to reduce; (dialect) to smart; (used after a verb) extremely

去.english: to go; to go to (a place); (of a time etc) last; just passed; to send; to remove; to get rid of; to reduce; to be apart from in space or time; to die (euphemism); to play (a part); (when used either before or after a verb) to go in order to do sth; (after a verb of motion indicates movement away from the speaker); (used after certain verbs to indicate detachment or separation)

舞.english: to dance; to wield; to brandish

裡.english: lining; interior; inside; internal; also written 裏|里[li3]

談.english: surname Tan; to speak; to talk; to converse; to chat; to discuss

灣.english: bay; gulf; to cast anchor; to moor (a boat)

機.english: surname Ji; (bound form) machine; mechanism; (bound form) aircraft; (bound form) an opportunity; (bound form) crucial point; pivot; (bound form) quick-witted; flexible; (bound form) organic

午.english: 7th earthly branch: 11 a.m.-1 p.m., noon, 5th solar month (6th June-6th July), year of the Horse; ancient Chinese compass point: 180° (south)

敲.english: to hit; to strike; to tap; to rap; to knock; to rip sb off; to overcharge

費.english: surname Fei; to cost; to spend; fee; wasteful; expenses

七月.english: July; seventh month (of the lunar year)

一種.english: one kind of; one type of

沒有.english: haven't; hasn't; doesn't exist; to not have; to not be

只有.english: only have ...; there is only ...; (used in combination with 才[cai2]) it is only if one ... (that one can ...) (Example: 只有通過治療才能痊愈|只有通过治疗才能痊愈[zhi3 you3 tong1 guo4 zhi4 liao2 cai2 neng2 quan2 yu4] "the only way to cure it is with therapy"); it is only ... (who ...) (Example: 只有男性才有此需要[zhi3 you3 nan2 xing4 cai2 you3 ci3 xu1 yao4] "only men would have such a requirement"); (used to indicate that one has no alternative) one can only (do a certain thing) (Example: 只有屈服[zhi3 you3 qu1 fu2] "the only thing you can do is give in")

一個.english: a; an; one; the whole (afternoon, summer vacation etc)

還有.english: there still remain(s); there is (or are) still; in addition

漫步.english: to wander; to ramble; recreational hiking; to perambulate

九月.english: September; ninth month (of the lunar year)

開放.english: to bloom; to open; to be open (to the public); to open up (to the outside); to be open-minded; unrestrained by convention; unconstrained in one's sexuality

工房.english: workshop; temporary housing for workers; workers' living quarters

天全.english: Tianquan county in Ya'an 雅安[Ya3 an1], Sichuan

以上.english: that level or higher; that amount or more; the above-mentioned; (used to indicate that one has completed one's remarks) That is all.

上面.english: on top of; above-mentioned; also pr. [shang4 mian5]

下去.english: to go down; to descend; to go on; to continue; (of a servant) to withdraw

談話.english: to talk (with sb); to have a conversation; talk; conversation; CL:次[ci4]

或是.english: or; either one or the other

不是.english: no; is not; not; fault; blame
